scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The theorem is supported by a full analytical proof; finite symbolic and high-precision tests are supplemental only.
limitations: General radial symbol injectivity from gamma-moment tails was established previously.
Finite-noise parameter stability is not proved.
An earlier Prony-type formulation may have the same inverse result; independent historical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact indexed spectrum and one occupied arc per radial period; fixed Bargmann–Fock Gaussian normalization; no unordered-spectrum or noisy finite-data claim.
